title: Global problems
about: Collocations for talking about the world's big problems: the environment (climate change, fossil fuels, irreparable damage), poverty (below the poverty line, sleep rough, alleviate poverty) and other issues such as asylum seekers, the death toll after an earthquake and child labour.

items.pattern: climate change (usually no article) · tackle / fight / slow down climate change · the effects of climate change
items.meaning: long-term changes in the earth's weather, especially the warming caused by people burning coal, oil and gas
items.example: Our local paper is running a series on how **climate change** is affecting farmers in the area.
more: My son's school project is about **climate change** and what families can do at home.
Warmer winters with hardly any snow are one sign of **climate change** that people notice first.
items.watchOut: Зміна клімату — climate change, зазвичай без артикля: Climate change affects everyone. Не the change of climate і не climate changing. Weather — погода в певний день, climate — погода впродовж багатьох років.

items.pattern: rising sea levels · sea levels are rising · a rise in sea levels
items.meaning: the sea slowly getting higher, mainly because ice is melting as the world gets warmer
items.example: **Rising sea levels** mean that some seaside villages may be under water within a hundred years.
more: The documentary showed Pacific islands where **rising sea levels** have already flooded farmland.
The town is building a higher sea wall because **sea levels are rising**.
items.watchOut: Rise — підніматися самому (sea levels are rising), raise — піднімати щось (raise your hand). Тому rising sea levels, не raising. «Рівень моря зростає» — зазвичай sea levels are rising, а не growing.

items.pattern: greenhouse gases · greenhouse gas emissions · the greenhouse effect
items.meaning: gases such as carbon dioxide and methane that trap heat around the earth and make it warmer
items.example: Cars, power stations and farm animals all produce **greenhouse gases**.
more: Our city wants to cut **greenhouse gas** emissions by half by 2035.
Planting trees is one way to take **greenhouse gases** out of the air.
items.watchOut: Парниковий — greenhouse (теплиця, парник), а не hothouse чи glasshouse. Gases — /ˈɡæsɪz/, з одним s. Перед іншим іменником — greenhouse gas без -es: greenhouse gas emissions.

items.pattern: disturb / upset the ecological balance · the balance of nature
items.meaning: change the natural relationship between plants, animals and the place they live in, in a harmful way
items.example: Bringing a new kind of fish into the lake could **disturb the ecological balance**.
more: Too many deer in a forest can **upset the ecological balance**, because they eat all the young trees.
When the frogs disappeared from the pond, **the balance of nature** was **disturbed** and mosquitoes took over.
items.watchOut: «Порушувати рівновагу» — disturb / upset the balance, а не break чи violate: violate — порушувати закон чи правила. Ecological — екологічний (про природу), не плутай з economical — ощадливий.

items.pattern: fish stocks · fish stocks fall / recover · protect fish stocks
items.meaning: the number of fish living in a sea, lake or river
items.example: Boats are allowed to catch less cod this year to protect **fish stocks**.
more: **Fish stocks** in the bay have started to recover since fishing was banned there.
Divers say that **fish stocks** around the reef have fallen sharply in ten years.
items.watchOut: Рибні запаси — fish stocks. Stock тут — запас, кількість, а не склад і не акції. Fish у цьому виразі без -es.

items.pattern: tackle pollution / a problem / an issue · also fight / reduce pollution
items.meaning: start dealing seriously with pollution in order to reduce it
items.uk: боротися із забрудненням, братися за проблему забруднення
items.example: The council plans to **tackle air pollution** by closing the city centre to cars on Sundays.
more: Volunteers clean the beach every month, but we need new laws to **tackle pollution** properly.
The country **tackled river pollution** by building better water treatment plants.
items.watchOut: «Боротися з проблемою» — tackle a problem, без with. Struggle with sth означає «мучитися з чимось, ледве давати раду»: I struggle with maths. Pollution — незлічуване, без -s.

items.pattern: exhaust fumes · traffic fumes · breathe in fumes · an exhaust pipe
items.meaning: the dirty gas that comes out of cars, buses and lorries
items.example: Cyclists on busy roads breathe in a lot of **exhaust fumes**.
more: The playground is right next to the motorway, so parents worry about **exhaust fumes**.
On a hot day the whole street smells of **exhaust fumes**.
items.watchOut: Вихлопні гази — exhaust fumes (рідше exhaust gases), а не exhausted gases: exhausted — дуже втомлений. Fumes майже завжди в множині.

items.pattern: fossil fuels · burn fossil fuels · move away from fossil fuels
items.meaning: fuels such as coal, oil and gas that formed in the ground over millions of years
items.example: Most of the country's electricity still comes from burning **fossil fuels**.
more: Coal, oil and gas are all **fossil fuels**.
Our family wants to stop using **fossil fuels**, so we're saving for a heat pump.
items.watchOut: Викопне паливо — fossil fuels, зазвичай у множині. Не excavated чи dug fuel: fossil — це «скам'янілість, копалина». Вимова: /ˈfɒsl/.

items.pattern: cause / do irreparable damage (to sth) · also irreversible damage
items.meaning: damage so bad that it can never be repaired or put right
items.example: The oil spill did **irreparable damage** to the coastline.
more: Forty years of smoking had caused **irreparable damage** to his lungs.
Doctors warned that the infection could cause **irreversible damage** to her hearing.
items.watchOut: Наголос на другому складі: irREParable /ɪˈrepərəbl/. Damage тут незлічуване: irreparable damage, без a і без -s; damages — гроші, які суд присуджує як компенсацію.

items.pattern: deplete the ozone layer · ozone depletion · a hole in the ozone layer
items.meaning: make the layer of ozone gas high above the earth thinner, so that it protects us less from the sun
items.example: Gases from old fridges and spray cans **depleted the ozone layer**.
more: The hole in **the ozone layer** above the Antarctic was discovered in the 1980s.
Since those gases were banned, **the ozone layer** has slowly been recovering.
items.watchOut: Deplete — зменшувати запас чогось (the ozone layer, supplies, savings); не плутай з delete — видаляти. Озоновий шар — the ozone layer, з the. Наголос в ozone на першому складі: /ˈəʊzəʊn/.

items.pattern: green politics · green issues / policies · the Green Party · go green
items.meaning: political ideas and parties that put protecting the environment first
items.example: My aunt got interested in **green politics** after the river near her house was polluted.
more: More and more young voters care about **green politics**.
The local elections showed that **green issues** matter to people in our town.
items.watchOut: Politics — політика як сфера, з -s, але дієслово зазвичай в однині: green politics is… Policy — конкретний курс, правила: the government's energy policy.

items.pattern: crops fail · crop failure · a poor / bad harvest
items.meaning: plants grown for food don't grow well or die, so there is little or nothing to harvest
items.example: When the rains came late for the third year running, the **crops failed** again.
more: After a cold, wet summer, half the potato **crop failed**.
**Crop failure** pushed up the price of bread across the region.
items.watchOut: Сільськогосподарські культури — crops, а не cultures: culture — культура (мистецтво, традиції). Неврожай — the crops failed, crop failure або a poor harvest.

items.pattern: a devastating famine / flood / earthquake / fire · devastate a region
items.meaning: a terrible lack of food (famine) or a flood that causes huge damage and suffering
items.example: The **devastating floods** destroyed bridges, roads and hundreds of homes in the valley.
more: Our history teacher told us about the **devastating famine** in Ireland in the 1840s.
A **devastating fire** destroyed the old market hall last winter.
items.watchOut: Голод як лихо в цілому регіоні — famine /ˈfæmɪn/; hunger — відчуття голоду, а також недоїдання як постійна проблема (world hunger). Devastating — нищівний (про подію), devastated — зруйнований (про місце) або приголомшений (про людину): the town was devastated.

items.pattern: a natural disaster · be hit by a natural disaster · disaster relief
items.meaning: an event caused by nature, such as a flood, earthquake or storm, that kills people or causes great damage
items.example: Our school collected blankets and tinned food for families who had lost their homes in a **natural disaster**.
more: Some parts of the world suffer from **natural disasters** almost every year.
Insurance doesn't always cover damage from **natural disasters**.
items.watchOut: Стихійне лихо — natural disaster, а не spontaneous чи elemental disaster: «стихійний» тут означає «природний». Вимова: disaster /dɪˈzɑːstə/.

items.pattern: escape (from) poverty · escape the poverty trap
items.meaning: manage to stop being poor
items.example: Her grandparents **escaped poverty** by moving to the city and opening a small bakery.
more: For many young people, education is the best way to **escape poverty**.
Moving abroad for work helped her whole family **escape from poverty**.
items.watchOut: «Вирватися з бідності» — escape poverty, з from або без нього. Run away зазвичай кажуть про втечу з місця чи від людей (з дому, від собаки), а не з бідності.

items.pattern: live below / above the poverty line
items.meaning: with less money than the official amount a person needs for basic things like food and housing
items.example: According to the report, one family in six in the region lives **below the poverty line**.
more: Many pensioners are living **below the poverty line**.
Even with two part-time jobs, she is only just above **the poverty line**.
items.watchOut: «За межею бідності» — below the poverty line, тобто «нижче лінії», а не behind the border. Межа тут — line, не border і не limit.

items.pattern: lift sb out of poverty · also bring / raise sb out of poverty
items.meaning: help people so that they stop being poor
items.example: Cheap loans for small farmers have **lifted** thousands of families **out of poverty**.
more: The new factory **lifted** the whole town **out of poverty**.
Free school meals alone won't **lift** a family **out of poverty**.
items.watchOut: Lift — піднімати когось чи щось, rise — підніматися самому, без додатка. Тому lift people out of poverty, не rise people. Прийменник — out of.

items.pattern: a simple / easy solution (to sth) · there's no simple solution
items.meaning: an easy way of solving a problem
items.example: Doctors say there's no **simple solution** to back pain: you need exercise, rest and patience.
more: Sometimes the **simple solution** is the best one: we just moved the desk closer to the window.
Everyone wanted a **simple solution** to the parking problem outside the school.
items.watchOut: Рішення проблеми — solution to a problem (з to). Decision — рішення, яке ухвалюють (make a decision), а не спосіб розв'язати проблему. «Легке рішення» — simple / easy solution, не light.

items.pattern: a widening gulf / gap between A and B · the gulf between rich and poor
items.meaning: a big difference between two groups of people that keeps getting bigger
items.example: There's a **widening gulf** between the families in the luxury flats by the river and those on the run-down estates behind them.
more: There's a **widening gulf** between what young people earn and what flats cost.
After the argument about the fence, the **gulf** between the two neighbours grew even wider.
items.watchOut: Gulf тут — не затока, а прірва, великий розрив між людьми. «Прірва між багатими й бідними» — a gulf / gap between rich and poor. Widening — від wide, «що розширюється».

items.pattern: a deprived region / area / family / childhood · deprivation
items.meaning: poor regions where people lack money, jobs, good housing and services
items.example: The government has promised new hospitals for the most **deprived regions** of the country.
more: The charity gives free books to schools in **deprived areas**.
He grew up in a **deprived** part of the north, where few people had jobs.
items.watchOut: Deprived /dɪˈpraɪvd/ — бідний, позбавлений нормальних умов життя. Не плутай з depraved — розбещений. Deprived of sth — позбавлений чогось: deprived of sleep.

items.pattern: live on the margins of society · marginalised groups
items.meaning: the position of people who are left out of normal life, for example because they are very poor
items.example: Many older people who live alone end up on **the margins of society**.
more: The project helps people living on **the margins of society** to find work and a home.
The club makes sure that nobody in the village is left on **the margins of society**.
items.watchOut: «На узбіччі суспільства» — on the margins of society: прийменник on, margins у множині. «На дні суспільства» англійською зазвичай at the bottom of society.

items.pattern: developing countries / nations / economies · the developing world · (opposite) developed countries
items.meaning: poorer countries that are trying to build up their industry and economy
items.example: Clean drinking water is still a problem in many **developing countries**.
more: Many **developing countries** depend on selling coffee, tea and cotton abroad.
Tourism brings much-needed money to many **developing countries**.
items.watchOut: Developing — ті, що розвиваються (бідніші); developed — розвинені (багаті). Одне закінчення змінює значення на протилежне.

items.pattern: sleep rough · a rough sleeper · rough is an adverb here, no -ly
items.meaning: sleep outside in the streets or parks because you have nowhere to live
items.example: On cold nights, volunteers bring soup and blankets to people who **sleep rough**.
more: After he lost his flat, he **slept rough** in the park for two months.
The number of people **sleeping rough** in the city has doubled in five years.
items.watchOut: Rough тут — прислівник без -ly: sleep rough, не sleep roughly. Не плутай зі sleep badly — погано спати. Sleep rough означає ночувати надворі, бо немає житла.

items.pattern: street children · children living on the streets
items.meaning: children who have no home and live and sleep in the streets of a city
items.example: The charity runs a shelter where **street children** can wash, eat and sleep safely.
more: She volunteered for a year at a school for **street children** in South America.
The number of **street children** in the city has fallen since the new centre opened.
items.watchOut: Street тут стоїть перед іменником як прикметник і не має -s: street children, не streets children. Можна сказати й homeless children.

items.pattern: live / end up on the streets · be homeless
items.meaning: have no home, so you live and sleep outside in a town or city
items.example: Without help from his sister, he would have ended up **living on the streets**.
more: Thousands of people **live on the streets** of the capital.
The film tells the story of a teenager who **lives on the streets** after running away from home.
items.watchOut: Безхатько живе on the streets (або on the street): прийменник on і артикль the обов'язкові. I live in Green Street — це лише адреса: я живу на вулиці Грін.

items.pattern: be in desperate need (of sth) · desperately need sth · also urgent need
items.meaning: needing something very much and very urgently
items.example: After the storm, hundreds of families were **in desperate need** of clean water.
more: The old village hall is **in desperate need** of a new roof.
The hospital is **in desperate need** of more nurses.
items.watchOut: «Гостра потреба» — desperate / urgent need, а не sharp need. Після in — прикметник (in desperate need), а прийменник далі — of: in need of sth.

items.pattern: poverty / unemployment / boredom breeds crime · breed – bred – bred
items.meaning: cause crime to appear and grow
items.example: Many people believe that bad housing and unemployment **breed crime**.
more: Boredom and nothing to do in the evenings can **breed crime** among teenagers.
Poverty doesn't always **breed crime**, but it can make it more likely.
items.watchOut: «Породжувати» — breed (буквально «розводити тварин»), не give birth to і не born. Crime тут незлічуване: злочинність загалом, без -s.

items.pattern: the global / world economy · a strong / weak economy
items.meaning: the economic system of the whole world, seen as one connected system
items.example: When **the global economy** slows down, poorer countries are often hit the hardest.
more: Coffee prices depend on **the global economy** as well as on the weather.
Our teacher explained how a war far away can affect **the global economy** and food prices at home.
items.watchOut: Economy — господарство країни чи світу; economics — економіка як наука (study economics). Economic — економічний, economical — ощадливий: an economical car.

items.pattern: a golden opportunity (to do sth) · miss / seize a golden opportunity
items.meaning: an excellent chance to do something, which may not come again
items.example: The new trade deal is a **golden opportunity** to create jobs in the region.
more: Living with a French family for a month was a **golden opportunity** to improve my French.
He missed a **golden opportunity** when he didn't apply for that job.
items.watchOut: Нагода — opportunity або chance, не possibility (ймовірність, що щось станеться) і не occasion (подія, привід). Golden, а не gold: gold — із золота (a gold ring).

items.pattern: combat / fight / tackle poverty (crime, disease)
items.meaning: take action to reduce poverty and stop it getting worse
items.example: The charity's main aim is to **combat poverty** in rural areas.
more: The city has a new plan to **combat** child **poverty**: free breakfast clubs in every school.
The new mayor says that better bus services will help to **combat poverty** in the suburbs.
items.watchOut: «Боротися з бідністю» — combat / fight poverty, без with. Families struggling with poverty — це інше: родини, які потерпають від бідності, ледве зводять кінці з кінцями.

items.pattern: eradicate poverty / a disease · eradication
items.meaning: get rid of poverty completely
items.example: The United Nations wants to **eradicate** extreme **poverty** by 2030.
more: The new president promised to **eradicate poverty** within ten years, but few people believed her.
Smallpox was completely **eradicated** in 1980.
items.watchOut: Eradicate — знищити повністю, назавжди (латинське radix — корінь, звідси «викорінити»). Наголос на другому складі: /ɪˈrædɪkeɪt/.

items.pattern: alleviate poverty / suffering / pain
items.meaning: make poverty less serious or easier to bear, without ending it
items.example: Small loans to local businesses can help to **alleviate poverty** in villages.
more: Many people believe charity can only **alleviate poverty**; to end it, you need jobs.
The nurse gave him something to **alleviate** the pain.
items.watchOut: Alleviate — пом'якшити, зробити легшим, а eradicate — знищити повністю. Не плутай з elevate — піднімати. Наголос: /əˈliːvieɪt/.

items.pattern: seek / ask for / apply for political asylum · be granted asylum · seek – sought – sought
items.meaning: ask to stay in another country because you are in danger at home, especially because of your political views
items.example: The journalist **sought political asylum** in Sweden after receiving threats.
more: Her grandparents **sought political asylum** in Britain in the 1970s and never went back.
The court decided the family could stay, and they were granted **political asylum**.
items.watchOut: Seek asylum — без for (але ask for / apply for asylum). Притулок тут — asylum /əˈsaɪləm/, а не shelter: shelter — укриття, дах над головою на ніч чи під час бурі.

items.pattern: an asylum seeker · a genuine asylum seeker · seek asylum
items.meaning: people who have left their country and asked another country to let them stay because they are in danger
items.example: Local families have offered spare rooms to **asylum seekers** while their cases are decided.
more: Most **asylum seekers** wait months for an answer from the authorities.
Our English class has two **asylum seekers** who are waiting to hear if they can stay.
items.watchOut: Шукач притулку — asylum seeker (від seek), а не asylum searcher. Часто розрізняють: asylum seeker ще чекає рішення, refugee — біженець, якого вже визнали або який утік від війни.

items.pattern: an economic migrant · economic migration · migrant workers
items.meaning: people who move to another country to find work and a better life, not because they are in danger
items.example: Many **economic migrants** send part of their wages home to their families.
more: In the 1960s, many **economic migrants** came to Britain to work in factories and hospitals.
Her parents were **economic migrants** who moved here to work on farms.
items.watchOut: Economic — пов'язаний з економікою; economical — ощадливий, економний (an economical car). Тому economic migrants, не economical. Заробітчани — теж economic migrants або migrant workers.

items.pattern: take to the streets (to protest / demonstrate / celebrate)
items.meaning: go out into the streets in large numbers to protest or celebrate
items.example: Thousands of nurses **took to the streets** to demand better pay.
more: Farmers **took to the streets** with their tractors to protest about food prices.
After the final, football fans **took to the streets** to celebrate all night.
items.watchOut: «Вийти на вулиці» на протест — take to the streets (take – took – taken), з прийменником to і streets у множині. Go to the streets так зазвичай не кажуть.

items.pattern: debt repayments · repay / cancel a debt · the debt of poorer countries (older: third-world debt)
items.meaning: money paid back regularly to the people, banks or countries you have borrowed from
items.example: Some poor countries spend more on **debt repayments** than on schools and hospitals.
more: Lower interest rates made the family's monthly **debt repayments** much smaller.
The campaign asked rich countries to cancel the **debt** of the world's poorest nations.
items.watchOut: Борг — debt /det/, b не читається. Duty — обов'язок або мито, не борг. Repayment — повернення позиченого; payment — будь-яка оплата.

items.pattern: an earthquake / a storm / a flood hits (strikes, devastates) a place · be hit by an earthquake
items.meaning: an earthquake happens in a place and causes damage there
items.example: When the **earthquake hit** the island, most people were asleep.
more: The town was **hit by** a strong **earthquake** in 1999, and many buildings had to be rebuilt.
A big storm **hit** the coast last night and brought down hundreds of trees.
items.watchOut: «У регіоні стався землетрус» — an earthquake hit / struck the region, без прийменника після hit. Happen не має додатка: не happened the region, а there was an earthquake in the region.

items.pattern: the death toll · the death toll rises / climbs to … · a massive / heavy death toll
items.meaning: the number of people killed in an accident, a disaster or a war
items.example: The **death toll** from the floods rose to forty yesterday.
more: Thanks to early warnings, the **death toll** from the storm was much lower than expected.
Newspapers reported a rising **death toll** after the earthquake.
items.watchOut: «Кількість загиблих» у новинах — зазвичай the death toll. Death rate — смертність, статистика (скільки людей помирає на тисячу населення), а не кількість загиблих в одній катастрофі.

items.pattern: the (sexual / economic) exploitation of children / workers · exploit sb · protect sb from exploitation
items.meaning: treating children (or other people) unfairly and cruelly in order to make money or get something from them
items.example: Several charities work together to end the **exploitation of children** in factories and on farms.
more: The documentary showed the **exploitation** of farm workers who were paid almost nothing.
Teachers are trained to spot signs of **exploitation** and report them.
items.watchOut: Exploitation — експлуатація людей, нечесне використання їхньої праці. «Експлуатація» машини чи будинку — operation або use, а не exploitation.

items.pattern: a worldwide / world-wide / global problem · worldwide = all over the world
items.meaning: a problem that exists in all parts of the world
items.example: Plastic in the oceans has become a **worldwide problem**.
more: Obesity in children is now a **worldwide problem**, not just a problem in rich countries.
Water shortages are a **global problem**, from Spain to India.
items.watchOut: Worldwide — по всьому світу. Worldly — досвідчений у життєвих справах (a worldly man), це зовсім інше. Пишуть worldwide або world-wide.

items.pattern: child labour · use / ban child labour · (US) child labor
items.meaning: work done by children, usually for very little money and in bad conditions
items.example: Before buying chocolate, she checks that it is made without **child labour**.
more: **Child labour** was common in British coal mines in the nineteenth century.
My great-grandmother started work in a cotton mill at twelve; today we would call that **child labour**.
items.watchOut: Дитяча праця — child labour, не children's work чи child work. Labour (британською з -our) — важка праця; незлічуване, без a і -s.

warmup.uk: Після втрати роботи вони опинилися за межею бідності.
warmup.q: After losing their jobs, they ended up below the poverty ___.
warmup.explain: Межа бідності — the poverty line. За межею бідності — below the poverty line.

warmup.uk: Минулого року острів пережив кілька стихійних лих.
warmup.q: Last year the island suffered several ___ disasters.
warmup.explain: Стихійне лихо — natural disaster: «стихійний» тут означає «природний». Spontaneous — спонтанний.

warmup.uk: Опозиційний політик отримав політичний притулок у Франції.
warmup.q: The opposition politician was given political ___ in France.
warmup.explain: Політичний притулок — political asylum /əˈsaɪləm/. Shelter — укриття, дах над головою.

warmup.uk: Ночувати на вулиці взимку дуже небезпечно.
warmup.q: Sleeping ___ in winter is very dangerous.
warmup.explain: Ночувати на вулиці, бо немає житла, — sleep rough, без -ly. Можна й sleep on the street(s), але обов'язково з the.

warmup.uk: Дитяча праця досі існує в багатьох країнах.
warmup.q: Child ___ still exists in many countries.
warmup.explain: Дитяча праця — child labour. Labour — важка праця, незлічуване слово.

warmup.uk: Багато з них — економічні мігранти, які приїхали на заробітки.
warmup.q: Many of them are ___ migrants who came here to earn money.
warmup.explain: Economic — пов'язаний з економікою; economical — ощадливий, економний.

warmup.uk: У цієї проблеми немає простого рішення.
warmup.q: There's no simple ___ to this problem.
warmup.explain: Рішення проблеми — solution to a problem. Decision — рішення, яке ухвалюють; exit — вихід із будівлі.

warmup.uk: Ця робота — чудова нагода побачити світ.
warmup.q: This job is a golden ___ to see the world.
warmup.explain: Нагода — opportunity (або chance). Possibility — ймовірність, occasion — подія, привід.

A.q: Petrol and diesel are made from oil, so they are ___ fuels too.
A.explain: Викопне паливо — fossil fuels: вугілля, нафта, газ.

A.q: Rising sea levels are mainly caused by ___ change.
A.explain: Зміна клімату — climate change, без артикля. Weather — погода в певний день.

A.q: Farmers lost a whole year's income when their crops ___.

B.q: Good, well-paid jobs are the best way to ___ people out of poverty.
B.explain: Lift sb out of poverty — вивести когось із бідності. Rise — підніматися самому, без додатка.

B.q: The charity doesn't just want to make poverty less serious: it wants to ___ it completely.
B.explain: Eradicate — викорінити повністю. Alleviate — лише пом'якшити, elevate — піднімати.

B.q: The refugee camp is in ___ need of medicine.
B.explain: Гостра потреба — in desperate need of sth. Sharp need — калька, а після in потрібен прикметник, не прислівник.

C.q: The hurricane ___ the coast on Tuesday night.
C.explain: Ураган чи землетрус hits / strikes a place. Happen не має додатка.

C.q: After the ferry sank, the ___ was not known for several days.
C.explain: Кількість загиблих — the death toll. Death rate — смертність, статистика.

C.q: Road accidents involving young drivers are a ___ problem.
C.explain: Worldwide — всесвітній, по всьому світу. Worldly — досвідчений у житті, earthly — земний (не небесний).

example.title: Our class project
example.uk:
Цього семестру наш клас робив проєкт про глобальні проблеми. Спочатку ми подивилися документальний фільм про зміну клімату. У ньому показали, як підвищення рівня моря загрожує маленьким островам і як вихлопні гази та викопне паливо, яке ми спалюємо вдома, додають у повітря парникових газів.

Потім до нас прийшла жінка з місцевої благодійної організації. Вона розповіла, що мільйони людей досі живуть за межею бідності і що простого рішення немає. Її організація допомагає людям, які ночують на вулиці в нашому місті, і утримує школу для безпритульних дітей за кордоном.

Ми побачили в цьому золотий шанс допомогти, тож влаштували продаж випічки й зібрали 400 фунтів. Це не викорінить бідність, але цих грошей вистачить на гарячі обіди в її притулку цієї зими, і полегшить скруту кількох родин.
example.en:
This term our class did a project on global problems. First we watched a documentary about [[climate change|a1]]. It showed how [[rising sea levels|a2]] threaten small islands, and how [[exhaust fumes|a7]] and the [[fossil fuels|a8]] we burn at home add [[greenhouse gases|a3]] to the air.

Then a woman from a local charity visited us. She said millions of people still live [[below the poverty line|b2]] and that there is no [[simple solution|b4]]. Her charity helps people who [[sleep rough|b9]] in our city and runs a school for [[street children|b10]] abroad.

We saw a [[golden opportunity|b15]] to help, so we held a cake sale and raised £400. That can't [[eradicate poverty|b17]], but it will pay for hot meals at her shelter this winter and [[alleviate|b18]] the hardship of a few families.
